name: Idaho Strategic Resources (IDR)
teaser: Hold, do not add. At $14.61 the shares trade 25.6% above my Base value of $11.63, and the maximum buy price is $6.69. The required margin of safety is 42.5% because Confidence is C (15/25). At today's spot gold price of about $3,476 the Base would be $9.83 and the verdict would be Reduce.
